prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Pale green comic odor spirals rise from his clothes; one little fly retreats wearing a miniature clothespin on its nose. No filth or gore. Entire figure, curly mustache, oblivious grin, clear broad silhouette.
